result.title: One Image Is Enough: Self-Generated Supervision for Personalizing Human Video Diffusion at Test Time
result.comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. 23 pages (8 main + 3 references + 12 supplementary), 11 figures, 19 tables. Code: https://github.com/SadmanPinon/one-image-is-enough
result.summary: Pose-driven human video diffusion animates a person from a single reference image and a target pose sequence, yet it struggles to preserve identity, rendering the face and garments unfaithfully as the pose departs from it. Personalization is the standard remedy, but its supervision is missing: one image fixes identity at a single pose, while a multi-pose subject video cannot be assumed in practice. Instead, we synthesize the missing supervision. A domain-tuned, pose-conditioned generator produces pseudo-ground-truth frames at selected key poses. An inference-time reference-only sampler steers these candidates toward the subject and keeps the most identity-consistent. A per-subject low-rank adapter then trains on static clips of them, configured from the reference alone, with no subject video, ground truth, or labels. Although lower in fidelity, these synthetic frames supervise more effectively than real ones. Real frames as captured carry motion that erodes the temporal prior, while a static clip conveys appearance alone. On TikTok and UBC Fashion, the adapted model improves the base on every metric, inverts the identity-versus-motion trade-off, and matches or surpasses adaptation on five real frames despite using none. Code and weights are available at https://github.com/SadmanPinon/one-image-is-enough.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究单张参考图驱动的人体视频扩散个性化：用姿态条件生成器在关键姿态合成伪真值帧，再由推理期仅参考图采样器筛选身份一致的候选，训练 per-subject 低秩适配器，无需真实受试者视频或标签。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但其「自生成伪监督＋按一致性筛选候选」以及区分外观与运动的监督构造方式，可能为 latent 推理轨迹的监督信号构造与视觉证据筛选提供可核查的方法线索。
